facts.text: Mountain men eat plain. Pass the stew, then I'll saddle up for the brumbies.
facts.why: Jim never says this. A quote page lists his real lines, such as 'I think they're trying to make a butler out of me.' and 'I'll be back for them... and for whatever else is mine.'
facts.fix: I think they're trying to make a butler out of me.

fix_note.text: I think they're trying to make a butler out of me.

facts.text: Spur's nightcap after a day digging for gold.
facts.why: The transcript has Spur as the mountain man with wallaby stew and no rum or hot milk; the rum is Clancy's, recalled as the dark rum drunk on the track.
facts.fix: Clancy's old dark rum, from the days on the track.

vibe.verdict: Jim's closing line, no wallaby stew, the colt reward and billy tea print on a station bill of fare, but it looks more like a wanted poster and the reward shows as 82 pounds and 100 pounds.

Swap 'Harrison's homestead roast' note 'The station house dinner' for a line about Jessica's table manners at the station
Rename 'Camp oven lamb stew' to 'Spur's mine camp stew' with a note from Spur's camp
